y-m-44-08.title: Umugqa ubuyela lapho kwakuyo, ngakho kungani indingilizi ingakwazi?
y-m-44-08.topic: Izimo lapho ukuhumushela kunemba umugqa noma indingilizi phezu kwayo ngokwayo
y-m-44-08.goal: Qhathanisa izibalo zezimo ezihumushelwe ukuthola isimo lapho umugqa unemba phezu kwawo ngokwawo (n = 2m), bese uchaza ukuthi kungani indingilizi ingenakho ukuhumushela okunjalo.
y-m-44-08.material: Uma uhumushela isimo epulanini lezixhumanisi m ngakwesokudla no-n phezulu, iphoyinti ngalinye lesimo lihamba ohlangothini olufanayo ibanga elifanayo. Ake sihambise umugqa y = 2x + 1 nendingilizi (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 9 bese sibheka imiphumela.
y-m-44-08.prereq.1: Ulwazi lwangaphambilini: indlela isibalo esishintsha ngayo ngaphansi kokuhumushela (shintsha u-x ngo-x − m no-y ngo-y − n), i-slope yomugqa, nenkaba ne-radius yendingilizi.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.prompt: Imiphumela yokuhlola kokuhumushela yembulwa oyedwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha umcabango onengqondo ngolwazi kuze kube manje.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, qhathanisa ngqo umphumela wokuhumushela nesibalo sokuqala bese ubhala ukuthi siyafana noma siyahluka.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ulwazi olusha lushintsha yini isinqumo sakho. Uma lungashintshi, bhala isizathu ngomugqa owodwa.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Lapho umugqa y = 2x + 1 wawuhanjiswa u-3 ngakwesokudla no-1 phezulu, waba ngu-y = 2x − 4. (Ungumugqa ohlukile kunalokho obungaphambi kokuhamba.)
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kungenzeka yini ukuhambisa lo mugqa phezu kwawo ngokwawo ngokuhumushela?
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngoba nje ukuhamba okukodwa kunikeze umugqa ohlukile, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi wonke ukuhumushela kwenza kanjalo. Kunesizathu sokuhlola ezinye izinyathelo.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ukuhumushela njalo kwenza umugqa ube umugqa ohlukile, ngakho akunakwenzeka ukuwuhambisa phezu kwawo ngokwawo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthe 'njalo' kusukela ekuhloleni okukodwa. Hlola futhi ngesiqondiso esihlukile sokuhamba.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kuye ngesiqondiso nebanga lokuhamba, ungaba umugqa ofanayo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqaphele ukuthi akumele uboshwe umphumela owodwa futhi kumele uhlole nezinye izinyathelo.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Lo mphumela owodwa kuphela awusitsheli; kumele sizame nezinye izinyathelo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sokubambezela isiphetho nokwenza okunye ukuhlola. Kunengqondo.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Lapho kuhanjiswa 1 ngakwesokudla no-2 phezulu, y − 2 = 2(x − 1) + 1, okungukuthi, y = 2x + 1, ngakho wafana nomugqa wokuqala.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Khona uma uwuhambisa u-2 ngakwesokudla no-4 phezulu, ingabe nawo uzoba umugqa ofanayo?
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Lapho kuhanjiswa nge-(2, 4), y − 4 = 2(x − 2) + 1, okungukuthi, y = 2x + 1, umugqa ofanayo futhi. Lokhu ngoba isiqondiso sokuhamba (1, 2) sihambisana ne-slope engu-2 yomugqa.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Uma ibanga lokuhamba lihlukile, umphumela nawo uhlukile, ngakho kuzoba umugqa ohlukile
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Noma ibanga lihlukile, ukuhamba ngesiqondiso esihambisana nomugqa kungaba nomugqa ofanayo. Qhathanisa isiqondiso sokuhamba ne-slope yomugqa.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ungumugqa ofanayo kuphela ku-1 ngakwesokudla no-2 phezulu, futhi akukho okunye kokuhamba okusebenzayo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: (2, 4), izikhathi ezi-2 zokuhamba (1, 2), inesiqondiso esifanayo. Kufake ngqo uhlole.

y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukuhamba m ngakwesokudla no-n phezulu kunikeza y = 2x − 2m + n + 1. Ukuze ifane nomugqa wokuqala y = 2x + 1, n = 2m iyadingeka. Manje cabanga ukuthi sihambisa indingilizi (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 9 m ngakwesokudla no-n phezulu.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuhumushela (m, n) ezihambisa indingilizi phezu kwayo ngokwayo?
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Inkaba yendingilizi isuka ku-(1, −2) iye ku-(1 + m, −2 + n). Ukuze indingilizi ifane, inkaba kumele ifane, ngakho kuphela (m, n) = (0, 0). Umugqa usengumugqa ofanayo uma ushibilika ngokuhamba ohlangothini lwawo, kodwa indingilizi ayinaso isiqondiso esinjalo.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ukuhamba okune-n = 2m kwenza indingilizi ibe phezu kwayo ngokwayo, njengomugqa, ngakho iyindingilizi efanayo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani enkabeni yendingilizi. Ngokungafani nomugqa, indingilizi ayinayo 'umkhondo' ohambisana nesiqondiso sokuhamba.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kuphela (0, 0). Noma yikuphi okunye ukuhamba kushintsha inkaba futhi kunikeza indingilizi ehlukile
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Unqume ngenkaba ne-radius yendingilizi. Noma ngokufanayo i-radius, inkaba ehlukile isho indingilizi ehlukile.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: I-radius iyafana, ngakho noma yikuphi ukuhumushela kunikeza indingilizi efanayo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: I-radius iyafana kodwa isikhundla siyashintsha. Hlola ukuthi inkaba yendingilizi iya kuphi.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Indingilizi iyindingilizi, ngakho noma yisiphi isiqondiso noma ibanga olishukumisa ngalo, ihlala injalo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukuba yindingilizi akusho ukuthi iba phezu kwayo ngokwayo. Qhathanisa izixhumanisi zenkaba.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kulula ukucabanga ukuthi 'ukuhumushela kwenza umugqa ube umugqa ohlukile'. Umcabango wakho washintsha kanjani ngokuya ngemiphumela yokuhlola? Kungani 'ukuhamba okuhambisa phezu kwakho ngokwakho' kuhlukile ku-mugqa nasendingilizini?

y-m-44-05.material: Lena yinkinga yokuthola iphoyinti u-Q olithola ngokubukisa iphoyinti u-P(4, 1) ngaphesheya komugqa u-m : y = x + 1. Amayunithi ashiyiwe.

다온 : "Khetha u-Q ukuze u-PQ uhlangane no-m engeleni elungile futhi indawo ephakathi luka-PQ isemgqeni u-m."

y-m-44-01.topic: Isethi yamaphoyinti asebangeni elifanayo namaphoyinti amabili (i-perpendicular bisector yocezu)
y-m-44-01.goal: Thola amaphoyinti ngesandla ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amaphoyinti alinganayo kumaphoyinti amabili akwenzi iphoyinti elilodwa kuphela kodwa umugqa, bese uchaza ngezibalo ukuthi kungani enza umugqa.
y-m-44-01.material: Kunamachweba amabili olwandle. Endizeni yama-coordinate (isikwele esi-1 = 1 km), ichweba A lise-(0, 0) futhi ichweba B lise-(6, 2). Ukuze isikebhe sokuhlenga sigijime ibanga elifanayo noma ngabe yiliphi ichweba elinengozi, ufuna ukusimisa endaweni esebangeni elifanayo namachweba omabili.
y-m-44-01.prereq.0: Isiqagelo sokulandelana kwesikole: I-H1 yalo msebenzi iyizinga lobunzima lale nqwaba yokukhiqiza kuphela futhi ayisho ukuthi ikharikhulamu imisa ibanga. Cabanga ukuthi umfundi usevele wafunda izibalo zezimo (imigqa nezindilinga) ku-Common Mathematics yesikole samabanga aphezulu.
y-m-44-01.prereq.1: Ulwazi lwangaphambilini: indlela yokuthola ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili endizeni yama-coordinate, nokubeka izibalo ezimbili zilingane nokunwebisa.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi umaka wonke amaphoyinti olwandle asebangeni elifanayo namachweba A no-B kokubili. Lawo maphoyinti enza isimo sini ndawonye?
y-m-44-01.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha iphoyinti elilodwa ngaphandle kuka-(3, 1), iphoyinti eliphakathi locezu AB, bese ubhala ibanga lalo kuya ku-A nebanga lalo kuya ku-B. (Isibonelo: (2, 4))
y-m-44-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thola amaphoyinti amathathu noma amane, uwabeke endizeni yama-coordinate, bese ubheka ukuthi aqondana ngesiphi isibalo.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.a: Iphoyinti eliphakathi kuphela lesigaba i-AB, akukho elinye iphoyinti
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.a: Iphoyinti eliphakathi lilodwa kumaphoyinti alingana ibanga. Khetha elinye iphoyinti bese uqhathanisa amabanga alo ku-A no-B.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.b: Iphoyinti kuleyo ndingilizi linebanga elifanayo kuphela no-A. Kule nkinga amabanga ku-A no-B kumele alingane komunye nomunye.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.c: Ilayini elilodwa elidlula iphoyinti eliphakathi lesigaba i-AB
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.c: Ungahlola lesi sibikezelo ngokuphawula amaphoyinti ambalwa bese ubheka ukuthi ahlelwa ngesimo sini.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.d: Ilayini eliphuma ezimbonini ezimbili u-A no-B
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.d: Amaphoyinti kulayini wa-AB avame ukuseduze nesizimbo esisodwa. Qhathanisa amabanga amabili usebenzisa amaphoyinti ambalwa kuwo.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.explain: Amaphoyinti alingana ibanga no-A no-B afaka hhayi iphoyinti eliphakathi (3, 1) lesigaba i-AB kuphela kodwa namaphoyinti akude afana no-(2, 4). Lawa maphoyinti alele kulayini odlula iphoyinti eliphakathi le-AB futhi ohlangana ne-AB ngengosi eqondile (i-perpendicular bisector yesigaba i-AB). Lokhu kuyisibikezelo kuphela okwamanje; esinyathelweni esilandelayo uzothola amaphoyinti ngokwakho ukuhlola.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.prompt: Endizeni yokuqondanisa, ngakwesokudla (ntshonalanga) ngu-x futhi phezulu (ngenyakatho) ngu-y. Izimbali zingu-A(0, 0) no-B(6, 2), futhi isikwele esingu-1 singu-1 km. Ufuna ukubeka isikebhe sokusiza endaweni ye-lattice (iphoyinti lapho x no-y kokubili kuyizinombolo eziphelele). Imibandela: ungasebenzisa kuphela ulwandle lapho x ≥ 0 no-y ≥ 0, iphoyinti lilingana ibanga no-A no-B, futhi liphakathi kuka-10 km ka-A. Thola futhi ufake izindawo ezi-3 ezihlukene.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.hint.0: Uma ukhetha iphoyinti, bhala isikwele sebanga eliya ku-A, x² + y², nesikwele sebanga eliya ku-B ngokwehlukana, bese uqhathanisa amanani amabili.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.hint.1: Misa u-x njengo-0, 1, 2, ... eyodwa ngesikhathi, bese ushintsha u-y futhi ufuna lapho amanani amabili alingana khona.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ungasebenzisa kuphela ulwandle lapho x ≥ 0 no-y ≥ 0.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Ibanga eliya ku-A nelibanga eliya ku-B ahlukile. Qhathanisa izikwele zawo.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.explain: Amaphoyinti e-lattice ahambisana nemibandela amane: (3, 1), (2, 4), (1, 7), (0, 10). Ahlelwa ngomthetho wokuthi y yehla ngo-3 njalo uma x inyuka ngo-1. (4, −2) liphandle kolwandle, ngakho lishiyiwe.
y-m-44-01.s.s3.prompt: Amaphoyinti owathole alele kulayini oyedwa. Amaphoyinti ambalwa abukeka njengelayini aqondile awanele ukusho ukuthi wonke amaphoyinti anjalo enza ilayini. Bhala ngamazwi akho ukuthi kungani umbandela webanga elilinganayo uba ilayini uma ubhalwa ngo-x no-y (noma yisiphi isizathu onaso sokukholwa ukuthi kuyilayini).
y-m-44-01.s.s3.hint.0: Thatha iphoyinti P(x, y) bese ubhala isibalo esimisa isikwele sebanga elisuka ku-P liye ku-A silingane nesikwele sebanga elisuka ku-P liye ku-B.
y-m-44-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nweba izinhlangothi zombili bese ubona ukuthi zikhona yini izigaba ezivela ezinhlangothini zombili.
y-m-44-01.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Ukubhala 'ibanga eliya ku-A lilingana nebanga eliya ku-B' njengesibalo kunika ...
y-m-44-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe incazelo yakho ihlukanisa 'amaphoyinti ambalwa abukeka njengelayini' no-'isibalo esifinyeziwe silayini'?
y-m-44-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlolile ukuthi kwenzekani ezigabeni ezifana no-x² no-y² esibalweni?
y-m-44-01.s.s3.model.0: Iphoyinti P(x, y) lilingana ibanga no-A no-B, ngakho PA² = PB², okungukuthi, x² + y² = (x−6)² + (y−2)². Uma unweba, u-x² no-y² ezinhlangothini zombili ziyabhubhisana, kusale isisho sedigri yokuqala ku-x no-y esinjengo-3x + y = 10, ngakho yilayini.
y-m-44-01.s.s3.model.1: Amaphoyinti amane owathole alele ngomugqa kuyisibonelo nje, hhayi ubufakazi. Uma usikwela umbandela webanga elilinganayo bese ufinyeza, izigaba ze-x² no-y² ziyabhubhisana ezinhlangothini zombili bese kusala isibalo sedigri yokuqala, ngakho ungasho ukuthi yilayini.
y-m-44-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo ephinde umcabango ofanayo ngokulandelana okuhlukile.

y-m-44-06.title: Ibhuthi eduze kwe-fountain: indawo emkhawulweni ivunyelwe?
y-m-44-06.topic: Amaphoyinti angaphakathi kwesifunda esinqunywe yindilinga nomugqa (izifunda zokungalingani, ukuthi umkhawulo ufakiwe yini)
y-m-44-06.goal: Esifundeni esinikezwe ngokungalingani kwendilinga nomugqa, funda ngokuhlukile kusimo ngasinye ukuthi umkhawulo ufakiwe yini, yenza amaphoyinti amaningana anelisa izimo, futhi uchaze umthelela wokushintsha isimo.
y-m-44-06.material: Imephu yepaki ibonisiwe endizeni yokuxhumanisa (isikwele esingu-1 = 10 m). I-fountain ku-(2, 1), futhi izindawo lapho ibhuthi ingasethwa khona yimaphoyinti e-lattice anelisa zonke izimo ezintathu ezingezansi. ㈎ Ibanga kusuka ku-fountain lingu-4 ubuningi (umkhawulo ufakiwe), okungukuthi, (x − 2)² + (y − 1)² ≤ 16. ㈏ Ngaphezulu komugqa u-y = x − 5, okungukuthi, u-y > x − 5 (indawo emgqeni iyindlela yokuhamba, ngakho ibhuthi ayikwazi ukusethwa). ㈐ x ≥ 0.

y-m-44-04.title: Isikhathi lapho unxantathu owenziwe ngamalayini amathathu unyamalala
y-m-44-04.topic: Izindawo zamalayini amathathu (ahlangana endaweni eyodwa, afanayo) nemibandela yokwenza unxantathu
y-m-44-04.goal: Hlola izimo lapho amalayini amathathu engenakwenza unxantathu (afanayo, ahlangana endaweni eyodwa) ngokulandelana ulwazi olwembulwa ngakho, bese ufinyeza isiphetho senani ngalinye lika-k.
y-m-44-04.material: Kunamalayini amathathu l₁ : y = x + 1, l₂ : y = −x + 5, l₃ : 2x − y = k. k i-constant. Kuye ngenani lika-k, amalayini amathathu angase aluzungeze unxantathu noma cha. Indlela yokufunda: l₃ ifundwa 'izikhathi ezi-2 x kususwe y kulingana no-k'.
y-m-44-04.thinking.2: Ukuthola isimo esikhethekile nokuchaza ukuthi kungani
y-m-44-04.prereq.1: Ulwazi lwangaphambilini: ukuthola ukuhlangana kwamalayini amabili, nokuthola indawo kanxantathu kusukela ekuqondanisweni kwama-vertex akhe amathathu (usebenzisa isisekelo nokuphakama noma usebenzisa ukuqondanisa).
y-m-44-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi mayelana namalayini amathathu lwembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi esinyathelweni ngasinye. Njalo, khetha umcabango onengqondo ngolwazi kuze kube manje.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, bhala ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye ye-'imibandela yokuba unxantathu wakheke' ulwazi olusanda kwembulwa olushintsha yona.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi kulungile ukugcina ukukhetha okufanayo noma kumele ushintshe isizathu.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Kunamalayini amathathu. l₁ : y = x + 1 (slope 1), l₂ : y = −x + 5 (slope −1), l₃ : 2x − y = k (slope 2, k i-constant engakamiswa). Ama-slope amalayini amathathu wonke ahlukile, ngakho akukho amabili afanayo.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Noma k iyiphi inombolo, amalayini amathathu awafani komunye nomunye. Khona-ke, noma k iyini, ingabe amalayini amathathu enza unxantathu?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukungabi khona kwamalayini afanayo kungomunye wemibandela yokwakheka konxantathu kuphela. Kungase kube khona, kuye ngo-k, enye indlela ukuthi unxantathu angakheki (amalayini amathathu ahlangana endaweni eyodwa), ngakho udinga ukuhlola.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Amalayini amathathu awafani komunye nomunye, ngakho unxantathu wakheka noma k iyini
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ingabe ucabange ngecala lapho amalayini amathathu ehlangana endaweni eyodwa? Ngisho noma engafani, unxantathu angase angakheki.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kuye ngo-k unxantathu angase angakheki, ngakho sidinga ukuhlola ngokwengeziwe
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ukhombise ukuthi 'akufani' kuphela akunquli isiphetho. Okusele ukuthola ukuthi yiliphi icala eliyinkinga.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uma kunamaphoyinti amathathu ahlukile okuhlangana, lawo maphoyinti amathathu aba ama-vertex kanxantathu.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Indawo yokuhlangana luka-l₁ no-l₂ ngu-(2, 3). Ukufaka u-(2, 3) esibalweni 2x − y = k luka-l₃ kunika u-4 − 3 = 1.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uma u-k = 1, imigqa emithathu yenza unxantathu?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma u-k = 1, u-l₃ naye udlula ku-(2, 3), ngakho wonke amaphoyinti amathathu okuhlangana ahlangana abe iphoyinti elilodwa u-(2, 3). Kusala iphoyinti elilodwa kuphela esikhundleni sikanxantathu, ngakho akwakhiwa unxantathu.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Indawo yokuhlangana u-(2, 3) isemigqeni yonke emithathu, ngakho kunamaphoyinti amathathu okuhlangana futhi kwakheka unxantathu
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Unxantathu wakheka kuphela uma amaphoyinti amathathu okuhlangana eyizinhlobo ezintathu ezihlukile zamaphoyinti. Kwenzekani uma indawo yokuhlangana yemigqa emithathu ihlangana ibe eyodwa?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Imigqa emithathu yonke iba yimigqa efanayo, ngakho akwakhiwa unxantathu
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuthambeka kwemigqa emithathu kuhlukile: 1, −1, 2, ngakho akunakuba yimigqa efanayo.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Imigqa emithathu ihlangana ephoyintini elilodwa u-(2, 3), ngakho akwakhiwa unxantathu
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ukhombise ukuthi bahlangana ephoyintini elilodwa, ngakho amaphoyinti amathathu okuhlangana ahlangana abe elilodwa.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Kulokhu ake u-k = 3. Indawo yokuhlangana luka-l₁ no-l₃ ngu-(4, 5), indawo yokuhlangana luka-l₂ no-l₃ ngu-(8/3, 7/3), nendawo yokuhlangana luka-l₁ no-l₂ ngu-(2, 3). Lawa maphoyinti amathathu angama-vertex kanxantathu.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uma u-k = 3, indawo kanxantathu ozungezwe yimigqa emithathu ingakanani?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Usebenzisa ama-vertex amathathu u-(2, 3), (4, 5), (8/3, 7/3), indawo ingu-4/3. Ukuthola indawo yokuhlangana yemigqa emibili, ukuhlola ukuthi ihlangana ephoyintini elilodwa yini, nokuthola indawo kanxantathu konke kuyaxhumana.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Leli nani liyizikhathi ezingu-2 zenani elithile. Hlola ukuthi ukhohlwe isinyathelo sokuhlukanisa ngo-2 lapho uthola indawo kanxantathu.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Faka ukuxhumanisa kwama-vertex amathathu futhi ubale futhi. Kungenzeka ukhethe isisekelo nokuphakama ngephutha.
